comment: Per-image size and boot-time budgets (F-PKG-05). A ceiling is the figure measured and written down in docs/BOOT-SPEED.md or docs/BETA-PLAN.md plus about 10 percent room; `measured` and `source` say where the number comes from. A ceiling of null means no budget yet: the checker reports it and does not pass or fail it. Raise a ceiling only in a commit that says why.

files.source: docs/BOOT-SPEED.md: root.sfs zstd level 3 is 220 MB

timings.label: QEMU power-on to the sign-in picture, median (dist/buildroot/boot-time.py)
timings.source: docs/BETA-PLAN.md: about 9 s to the first shell picture; not re-measured for this file

memory.label: RAM in use at the sign-in screen

files.source: FEATURES.md F-PKG-05: Libre ISO about 63 MB

web.label: Web image (libre + the full web engine: iris, Brotli, WOFF2, WebRTC media, VA-API; the consolidated rebuild of 2026-11-13)
web.note: PROPOSED by the build host: each ceiling is the figure measured on the amd-mini build (docs/BROWSER-SPEED.md, built 2026-11-13) plus about 5 percent, rounded up to a whole megabyte. The OWNER should confirm these limits (the full image is 190 MB for the initrd; the web engine alone is 119 MB, which is why this row is higher).
